description:
Implement SOVA for convolutional codes, enabling soft-output decoding. This extends the existing hard-decision Viterbi decoder to produce reliability information, which is needed for turbo-like iterative decoding schemes.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Delivers “Implement Soft-Input Viterbi Algorithm (SOVA)” with the behavior, scope, evidence, and constraints described above.
title: Implement Soft-Input Viterbi Algorithm (SOVA)
